figures.title: Drunk-driving deaths, 2024
wording: In 2024, 11,904 people died in drunk-driving crashes, where a driver had a BAC of .08 or higher. That's about 30% of US traffic deaths, or one person every 44 minutes.

figures.title: Alcohol-related deaths at a BAC of .01 to .07, 2024
wording: In 2024, 2,028 people were killed in alcohol-related crashes where a driver had a BAC of .01 to .07.
Even a small amount of alcohol can affect driving.

figures.title: Drugs detected at studied trauma centers, October–December 2020
wording: 56% of drivers in serious-injury and fatal crashes at studied trauma centers tested positive for at least one drug (Oct–Dec 2020).
figures.note: This figure is for studied trauma centers in October–December 2020. It is not a national drug-impaired death count.

figures.title: Self-reported driving under the influence, 2023
wording: In 2023, among people 16 and older, 15.5 million (5.9%) drove under the influence of alcohol, 12.1 million (4.6%) drove under the influence of cannabis, and 2.2 million (0.8%) drove under the influence of other illicit drugs in the past year.
figures.source: CDC, Impaired Driving Facts, citing the 2023 National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH). Page updated 28 January 2026.
